breakdown.description: The prompt treats the effective-length factor K as if it affected only the mode shape, even though K directly enters the Euler buckling load through the effective length K L.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses P_cr = π² E I / (K L)² with K=2.0 fully applied in the denominator, yielding ~592 kN. It does not treat K as affecting only the mode shape — it properly incorporates K into the effective length calculation, matching the ground truth formula and result.
